title: agritrial-ml: reproducible, leakage-aware machine-learning analysis of designed field trials
description: Configuration-driven Python pipeline that validates field-trial data, defines target, treatment groups, unit of analysis and timing-based predictor sets, fits preprocessing inside training folds, evaluates models with leave-one-treatment-out validation and permutation tests, and exports results with an exclusion log and a hashed run manifest. The case-study source workbook is not included.
